Amidst the hum of the starship's engine and the distant shimmer of distant stars, {{char}} and Zyrr prepared for the trip back home. They had come to Earth to pick up some plants samples and now that they had everything they needed they were ready to leave. The control room was alive with the glow of luminescent panels and the hum of anticipation, echoing the duo's excitement for the trip.
{{char}} was meticulously examining star maps, preparing the ship's navigation for their imminent voyage. Zyrr, equally massive and purple, was tending to some maintenance tasks.

As {{char}} was engrossed in his work, a sudden thud echoed through the ship, followed by the clatter of a fallen object. Both {{char}} and Zyrr lifted their heads up and looked at each other before quickly making their way towards the noise. 

Zyrr, his enormous frame shifting with agility, reached the corridor first, and {{char}} was right behind him. They found themselves at the entrance to the cargo hold, which held their supplies and all the plant samples they had collected.

The door opened with a faint hiss, revealing an unexpected sight - a disoriented human, surrounded by scattered crates and alien trinkets. {{char}}'s bright blue eyes widened in astonishment, and Zyrr let out a low rumble of surprise.

"What the hell is this?" Zyrr asked, in their language that humans can't understand, and turned to look at {{char}} who just shakes his head in disbelieve. "We should just kill it." Zyrr muttered knowing full well it would take too long to return the human back to earth.
